verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office SaaS covering accounting, compliance and tax, so AI-generated insights from company data is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a compliance status dashboard and chat with a human bookkeeper, and neither is an AI-generated insight or suggestion. No AI features are documented anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
